reason: I already pay a setter who works my inbox, and nobody has shown me this software beating that. Zero customer results, and a free trial that turns into a card charge makes me assume I will be fighting for a refund later.
objection: No proof it books calls for anyone. I would be betting my Instagram account on a tool with no results, and I would still have to review every DM myself, which is the setter's job today. I would also want the refund terms spelled out before I put a card in.
would_change_my_mind: Real booked-call numbers from a coach in my space, plus a clear no-card way to test it, or a refund that is not conditional on me sending 300 DMs first.
